name: Firehorse sections
note: The map from a data kind to the Firehorse section that shows it. An agent looks the kind up and uses the section it names; a kind with no entry is a Firehorse gap. Every section is the shell (fh-panel-section) plus a kind modifier. Docs: https://firehorse.rascode.dev/components/sections/

sidecar.chips: One chip row in the header: the record's state, in at most four chips. Chips appear nowhere else in the body, except one status chip a row may carry (a log line level, a prompt state).

detail: next (the record a swap goes to, else null)
fh:sidecar-before-close.when: The sidecar is dirty (data-dirty, set by an input or change inside a form section) and is about to close or swap to another record. preventDefault() keeps it open on its record. With no listener it closes as before. A submit the page does not cancel, or a form reset, clears data-dirty.

shell.icon: Required, first. An fh-icon with class fh-panel-section__icon; the section's tone colours it.
shell.title: An h3 with class fh-panel-section__title. Larger than body text, in the strongest text role.
shell.collapse: The summary is the control. Open by default unless the kind says otherwise.
shell.chips: In fh-panel-section__chips inside the summary. Shown only while collapsed. A row in the body may carry one status chip (fh-chip fh-chip--tone fh-chip--sm with a status tone), for status only: a log line level, a prompt state. No other chips in rows.

templates.note: A page picks one template, places it in fh-main, and fills its regions with Firehorse parts. It never sets its own layout. Templates use fh-record and fh-section-card, which are in the core bundle: firehorse.css is all a page needs. Docs: /components/sections/#TPL

nav.markup: one <nav class="fh-tabs fh-tabs--sub" aria-label="..."> of links, one per page of the area, the landing page first; the current page's link carries aria-current="page"; an optional count is one fh-badge after the label (counts only); no chips, no icons
nav.use: optional; when an area has more than one page every page of the area carries the same tabs in the same order
nav.place: directly after the header, before whatever the template puts next
nav.max: ten tabs at most, labels of one or two words
nav.narrow: under 36rem the tabs stay on one line and scroll sideways inside the region, the current tab scrolled into view by CSS, and by tabs-nav.js where the browser does not snap on first layout; the page never scrolls sideways

regions: metrics (fh-metrics fh-metrics--four: exactly four fh-metric, each with label, value, line and source)
landing.use: The top page of an area.

regions: filters (fh-search, fh-select filters (a select names its filter in its first option), fh-chip filters)
list.use: A page that is one table of records.

regions: cols: main (fh-section-card) and side (fh-panel-section); side drops under main below 60rem

empty.use: An area with nothing in it yet.

reference.attributes: href (the record page) and data-sidecar (the record id, opened by the sidecar opener)
reference.gone: fh-ref fh-ref--gone with fh-ref__note: not a link, says what happened

datatable.row: tr with data-sidecar and tabindex=0; every td has data-label; first cell is fh-ref (second, after the toggle cell, in an expandable row); the row's status is the Values dot and word (VAL-1.1, decision 5)

expand.toggle: first cell of the row: , no data-label; the header cell above it is Open. The chevron turns when aria-expanded is true.
expand.detail: …, directly after its record row. It holds any content: a stage (div.fh-panel-section__stage, then an optional p.fh-panel-section__caption with the code) or a nested fh-dt fh-dt--records (a list of variants), which indents once, under the reference cell.
expand.state: aria-expanded on the toggle and hidden on the detail row. A server renders either state; nothing needs datatable.js.
expand.script: records.js (optional): a click on the toggle flips aria-expanded and hidden (the row named in aria-controls, else the detail row right after) and fires fh:record-toggle { open, toggle, detail } on the toggle. sidecar.js never opens the row's sidecar from a click or key on the toggle.

values.warning: A quiet warning edge on the inline start and a tint, both from --fh-color-warning. It stays through hover, aria-selected="true" and the stacked rows. Pair it with the row's status chip (data-status="warn" or the value that says why).

states.none: No data-state is the plain row.

datatable.narrow: rows stack under 36rem; an expandable row keeps the toggle and the reference cell on its first line with the other cells under the reference, and its detail row stacks under it as one block

chips.status: fh-chip fh-chip--tone fh-chip--sm with data-status; the tone follows the value. In the record header, a collapsed section summary, and once per row.
chips.inline: fh-status: inline status text only, never in a header or a row

css.metrics: firehorse.css (fh-metric is in the core bundle)

chips.rule: The two or three values that matter most (status, owner, duration).

prose.body: columns, then rows; every reference in a cell is a link that opens that record's sidecar

chips.rule: The record count, then the count that needs attention.

prose.date: day mark (tr.fh-panel-section__day before the first row of each day: one th colspan=3 scope=colgroup, Label tier, e.g. Sat 15 Nov; no details, no control; stays one full-width row when the table stacks)
prose.title: step (td data-label=Step)
prose.sub: detail (td data-label=Detail; under 36rem the table stacks by data-label, the fh-table reflow rule)

chips.rule: The step count and the span, first time to last.
The event count and the time of the last event.

chat.body: fh-chat > fh-message (fh-message__head: fh-message__name, fh-message__time); a long message in fh-fold (fold.js)

chips.rule: The message count and the time of the last one.

activity.body: fh-activity-log (TML-2.1 Thread log): fh-activity-log__bar with the Rendered | Plain text switch; fh-activity-log__list > fh-activity-log__entry (actor avatar; fh-activity-log__head: actor, kind chip, time; fh-activity-log__summary; markdown body in fh-fold; fh-activity-log__links; images in fh-activity-log__media > fh-image-stack). activity-log.js, fold.js, image-stack.js

prose.who: actor (an agent: data-kind=agent avatar, its logo or tone; a person: a circle)
prose.kind: kind (action, update, note, verify, commit, fix, error: the work log's event kinds)

chips.rule: The entry count and the span of time it covers.

prose.chips: level (the row status chip, toned by data-tone on the row)

chips.rule: The line count and the count of warnings or errors, if any.

prompts.body: fh-prompts > li > a.fh-prompt (fh-prompt__key, fh-prompt__version, status chip, fh-prompt__meta)

chips.rule: The prompt count and the dispatch they belong to.
The headline figures, as value and unit.

prose.label: label
prose.link: link that opens the record's sidecar

chips.rule: The linked count.
The file count and the total size.

form.body: form > fieldset of fh-field (any Fields member, fh-money included) and fh-panel-section__slot, then fh-panel-section__actions; or, when a field in the slot renders its own form, div.fh-panel-section__form (role=group, aria-labelledby the title id) in place of the form, holding the same parts
form.hostForms: Use form when the section submits its own fields. Use div.fh-panel-section__form when a field in the slot renders its own form (a Pro key field). Never put a form inside a form. The layout rules reach the direct child of fh-panel-section__body only, so a host field's own editor is not restyled. sidecar.js marks dirty on input or change inside the section either way, and a submit from a nested host form clears data-dirty unless the page cancels it.

prose.fields: fields; a read only value goes in the field's hint (fh-field__hint); and the slot for a host field (fh-panel-section__slot, data-slot=field)
prose.actions: actions (fh-panel-section__actions: save button, optional second action, one inline fh-status)

states.changed: data-dirty on the section (sidecar.js sets it, and on the sidecar)
states.saving: aria-busy on the form (or the div body), save button disabled
states.saved: one fh-status (data-tone lime) in the actions row
states.error: aria-invalid and fh-field__error on the field; one fh-status (data-tone danger) in the actions row for an error that belongs to no field
states.locked: fieldset disabled, one line fh-panel-section__note above the fields, save button disabled

chips.rule: The field count, then the count that still needs a value or holds an error.

stage.body: div.fh-panel-section__stage holding one component's markup, rendered live, then an optional p.fh-panel-section__caption with the component's code in a code element

prose.stage: stage (fh-panel-section__stage): the component's markup and nothing else
prose.caption: caption (fh-panel-section__caption, optional): the code, e.g. BTN-1.2

rules: No site or app chrome inside the stage: no site-* helper, no host wrapper, no second component around the first.

The stage is a container (container-type: inline-size) and its own stacking context (isolation: isolate), so the component answers the stage's width and its z-index stays inside; it scrolls (overflow: auto) when the component is larger.
It works in a dialog sidecar and in an aside. The stage box alone may fill a records detail row (cells.datatable.expand).

chips.rule: The code shown, then its status.

code.body: one fh-code per file: figcaption (file name, language chip, checksum in fh-value--mono with its copy action, Copy button), pre > code of span.fh-code__line rows
slots: line (fh-code__line, numbered by a CSS counter)

chips.rule: The language and the line count. Several files use the file count in place of one language.

document.body: rendered prose (fh-prose, headings stepped down under the h3 title: h4, then h5) inside fh-fold past about 24 lines; tables are fh-table; code is fh-code
slots: fold (fh-fold, Show all past about 24 lines)

chips.rule: The word count and the updated date.

tree.body: ul.fh-tree of nested rows: details when a row has children, a plain row when it does not; each label is a reference (a with data-sidecar) with an icon and a muted mono meta

chips.rule: The node count and the depth.

gallery.body: ul.fh-gallery of square thumbnails (li > button > img with its alt), each with an optional caption and kind chip; the grid fills by the section's width (container query); a thumbnail opens the Image stack viewer (IMS-2.1) at that image and the arrow keys walk the set; fh-empty when there are none
slots: thumbnail (button holding the img, alt text required)

chips.rule: The image count and the newest date.

matrix.body: fh-table fh-matrix inside fh-table-wrap: capability rows (th scope=row holding a reference that opens its record) by role columns (a short label at the Label tier); cells data-included true (toned check), false (ghost dash) or inherited (hollow check, muted), each with its word in fh-sr-only; a wide matrix scrolls inside the section with the capability column and the head held

chips.rule: The capability count and the role count.

chart.body: one figure.fh-chart per chart (fh-chart--line or fh-chart--bar) with a figcaption: inline SVG with a viewBox and no script, gridlines in the border colour, each series toned by data-tone; HTML axis labels at the Meta tier, values at the Value tier; a legend list under the chart and a visually hidden table with the same data; it scales with its container
slots: x axis (ol.fh-chart__x, Meta tier; a bar's value in fh-chart__value)
legend (ul.fh-chart__legend, a name and its value)

chips.rule: The last value and the change.

diff.body: one figure.fh-code.fh-diff per file: figcaption (file name, the change counts as chips, the two versions in fh-value--mono), pre > code of span.fh-code__line rows with data-diff add (soft lime), del (soft rose), ctx or hunk (muted); the gutter holds the row number (data-n) and its + or - mark, neither copied; fh-diff--split puts old and new side by side in span.fh-diff__row of two span.fh-diff__side from 40rem of the block, and stacks to unified under it
slots: line (fh-code__line, data-diff add, del, ctx or hunk; data-n)
split row (fh-diff__row: fh-diff__side data-side old, new)

chips.rule: The lines added and removed. Several files lead with the file count.

board.body: ol.fh-board of li.fh-board__column, one per status: a details.fh-board__fold whose summary is the status chip (data-status) and a count badge, then ul.fh-board__cards; a card is a.fh-board__card with data-sidecar: the title at the Value tier, a meta line (the id in mono, the due date) at the Meta tier, the owner avatar (a circle for a person) and one chip. From 40rem of the body the columns sit side by side, stay open and scroll sideways inside the section; under 40rem they stack and each folds. No drag: a card moves by the status picker in its sidecar. Firehorse Pro (pro/src/pm/board.css)
slots: meta (fh-board__meta: code id, time due; data-overdue in the danger tone)

chips.rule: The open count and the done count.

fields.note: Form fields that need more than a native input. Docs: /forms/#FLD

money.input: fh-input-group: a currency prefix (fh-money__currency) or a select (fh-money__select), a text input with inputmode=decimal, and a hidden input with data-fh-money-value
money.posts: Whole minor units (cents) as a digit string. Without the script the visible input posts what was typed.
money.use: Any amount of money in a form. Never type=number.
